skill.summary: Manage GitHub issues by listing, filtering, spawning fix agents, creating PRs, and tracking review comments using the authenticated gh CLI.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of GitHub Issue Manager skill.
- Fetch and filter GitHub issues by labels, milestones, and assignees.
- Spawn sub-agents to work on issue fixes.
- Create pull requests with automated descriptions.
- Track PR review status and handle review comments.
- Requires preconfigured and authenticated GitHub CLI (`gh`).
